title: Shiraishi An — Swaying On The Road At Dusk〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Swaying On The Road At Dusk（4★）

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Man, I slept great...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you sure about that? Your eyes are barely open.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You slept like a baby in the car on the way back, An.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so much so that Azusawa had trouble getting you to wake up even after we arrived. She shook and poked you quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, Kohane.
I needed some sleep after staying up late practicing last night...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I was barely able to keep my eyes open after I basically went HAM at today's event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did put on a powerful performance today, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So powerful that you gave the rest of us a huge boost of energy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Then, I guess it was worth going all out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, what made you want to do that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm curious as well. You seemed much more motivated than usual today. Did something good happen recently?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, duh!
It's all because of your song, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My song?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I dunno why, but I feel really excited...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, Akito reignited our audience, Toya wrote an amazing song for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I feel that I've also gotta do what I can!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so like you to feel that way, An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, you've been like this for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember when you lost in that one event a really long time ago...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: An lost...?

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: But she did pretty well considering how young she is.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (I heard this was going to be a pretty high-level event, so I thought I could learn a few things by observing...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But... I never imagined her losing.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (To be fair, people have been saying how the team she just battled against got scouted recently...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (They came in, took control by creating an electric atmosphere. It was almost like this was their home turf. I know she's good, but I don't think she stood a chance.)
One week later

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: I thought the same thing last week, but the people who perform here are really good...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (But the team that beat Shiraishi last time was something else. I've gotta think they're gonna win again... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Last but not least, we have An Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line:
An...?
Was she on the list of performers...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Sorry, I know it was a big ask!
But thanks for letting me jump in at the last minute!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Losing left a really sour taste in my mouth, so I came back for a rematch!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
Geez...
After getting clobbered last week...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(Whoa...
How much did she practice since then?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (It hasn't even been a week, but she's closed the gap and overtaken them...!)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, I have the results! The winner is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah! I remember now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That happened?
That's so cool, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was super duper frustrated that time, so I decided to do everything I could to make them eat their words.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which I was going to achieve at the next event! And then I practiced like crazy. Haha. Those were some good times!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You practiced like crazy...? It's incredible how you were able to become so good in little under a week.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was surprised too...
Seriously, just how much do you hate losing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you're one to talk.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Regardless, Shiraishi, I'm glad to hear that my song was able to motivate you so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it gave me a huge boost of energy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Not only is Toya growing at a really fast rate, so is everyone else.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which means I don't have time to dawdle! We've gotta keep moving forward together!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's keep doing our best, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya, Kohane & Akito
rows.Line:
Yes.
Yeah!
Yeah.
